def_en: 1) to be prudent, be circumspect, wisely understand, prosper
1b1) to look at or upon, have insight
1b2) to give attention to, consider, ponder, be prudent
1b4) to cause to consider, give insight, teach
1b5) to act circumspectly, act prudently, act wisely
kjv: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.
expl: to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent
